detail: Work area 600 × 300 mm (600 × 3000 mm with the Conveyor) · cuts 20 mm acrylic, 15 mm walnut ply with the stock short-focus lens (18 mm with the medium/long lens) · BirdsEye bed camera + toolhead camera · dual lasers and encoders · crossflow ventilation, hose and fan included · 780 W max, 100–240 V · dual-band Wi-Fi, USB · Bambu Suite (macOS/Windows) · Class 1 enclosed as standard
uses: Cutting and engraving sheet stock — ply, MDF, acrylic, leather, card — for enclosures, panels, jigs and signage; engraving on wood, anodised aluminium and glass. Becomes Class 4 once the Riser Base is fitted: CO₂ laser eyewear required.

title: Bambu Lab Riser Base
name: Riser base for the R1 — taller workpieces, and the mount for the Conveyor and Rotary
detail: Raises the R1 by 57 mm · max workpiece height 248 mm · powered from the R1 over an 8-pin Bambu Bus cable · open-door detection on front, front-upper and rear doors · 4 flame sensors · required for the Automatic Conveyor Feeder and the Rotary Attachment · makes the machine Class 4
uses: Fitting thick or bulky items that won't go in the stock R1 (boxes, bowls, assembled parts); the base the Conveyor and Rotary bolt onto.

title: Bambu Lab Automatic Conveyor Feeder
name: Pass-through feeder for long stock on the R1
detail: Feeds stock 450–1500 mm with the guide rail, up to 3000 mm with three extension sets · work area becomes 600 × 3000 mm · conveyor roller + support roller assemblies, 4 guide rails, smoke curtain mount, sensor light shield · 6-pin Bambu Bus to the Riser Base · needs the Riser Base · material may overhang the rail by 200 mm at most
uses: Long panels, strips and signage in one job instead of tiling — fascias, battens, cable trays, lengths of acrylic.

title: Bambu Lab Rotary Attachment
name: Rotary holder for engraving round objects on the R1, with installation bracket
detail: Two-range chuck with a clip to switch between small and large objects · support module, claw, tape measure and spirit level in the box · 4-pin Bambu Bus cable · R1 version ships with the installation bracket · needs the Riser Base
uses: 360° engraving on cups, tumblers, bottles and tubes.

title: ASUS ProArt PA27JCV
name: 27-inch 5K IPS monitor with Auto KVM and 96 W USB-C
detail: IPS, 10-bit · 99% DCI-P3, 100% sRGB, 95% Adobe RGB, ΔE < 2, Calman Verified · VESA DisplayHDR 500 · LuxPixel AGLR anti-glare coating · USB-C with DP Alt Mode and 96 W PD, HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort 1.4, USB 3.2 hub (A + C), headphone jack · Auto KVM between two hosts · stand: 130 mm height, tilt −5°/+23°, swivel ±30°, pivot ±90°
uses: Main desk screen shared between the two laptops over the Auto KVM — work machine on HDMI/DP, personal on USB-C, one keyboard and mouse. Colour-accurate for layout, PCB and render work.
